registered_gate.timestamp_convention: UTC open-time labels; prices available after bar close
registered_gate.extended_inventory: All frozen liquidation-fade symbols and eight original majors, plus required daily books; inspect timestamp coverage without computing signals, PnL, or gates. Additional recovery ranges require a documented data-scope addendum before consuming them.
permitted_public_sources: data.binance.vision Binance USD-M futures klines/markPriceKlines/indexPriceKlines and CHECKSUM files
Official Binance public archive listing metadata
Official Binance unauthenticated USD-M historical price endpoints
Official Binance announcements and exchange documentation; historical applicability must be proved for settlement rules
registered_gate.identity_policy: Old and successor tickers are separate instruments unless explicit exchange evidence establishes contract continuity. Spot conversion ratios do not establish futures position transfer.
settlement_required_fields: official event source and publication time
last-trading and settlement timestamp with timezone
settlement price or exact reconstructable price rule and genuine required observations
fee and realized funding cutoff treatment
explicit successor treatment or separate-contract classification
registered_gate.bar_acceptance: Only authentic observed bars with valid provider checksum where supplied, exact interval/schema/units, unique monotone UTC timestamps, finite positive OHLC and nonnegative volumes/trade counts, OHLC consistency, complete target coverage, and explicit overlap comparison. Duplicate conflicts, source failures and unexplained revisions block admission. Preserve all existing rows byte-for-byte at row-value level; insert only proven missing timestamps. Do not invent zero-volume or interpolated bars.
registered_gate.provenance: Exclusive versioned raw receipts and derived outputs; URL/parameters/status/retrieval UTC/raw SHA256/provider checksum/transform commit/schema/units/old-source hashes/range coverage/overlap conflicts. Original stores and September9 results remain immutable.
registered_gate.stop_rule: Finish a recovery/readiness report even if evidence is unavailable. No strategy metric or verdict may be calculated under this key. Once data and accounting semantics are verified, register a separate fixed-cell replay before any results; retain every original affected cell and original gates. No new signal, tuning, forecasting refit, holdout, authenticated API, secret read, live order, or VPS operation.
